memory_candidates.content: When asserting 'exactly one occurrence of X' via grep -c against a script's own combined stdout/stderr, check whether any OTHER line in that same output references X in prose (e.g. a trailing summary line saying 'see X lines above') before trusting the count -- it will double-count. Prefer matching a more specific anchor (e.g. a trailing colon that only the real per-item line carries) over the bare phrase.
